boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Calvin University
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe food stops ranging from Calvin's on-campus Commons to late-night counters, carryout shops, and 24-hour diners around Grand Rapids.

cards.title: Commons Building After Hours
cards.subtitle: The on-campus option with a 2 a.m. building close
cards.notes: Stay on campus and check the dining schedule before heading over; the building remains open later than its individual food counters.
cards.short_summary: A central Calvin building that houses Commons Dining Hall, Uppercrust, and Johnny's Café.
cards.evidence_claim: Calvin identifies Commons Building as home to several dining locations and lists building hours through 2 a.m. Monday–Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Building hours are 6:30 a.m.–2 a.m. Monday–Saturday and 7 a.m.–9 p.m. Sunday; individual dining-counter hours differ.

cards.title: The All-Night IHOP Table
cards.subtitle: A 24-hour dine-in stop on 28th Street SE
cards.notes: Choose this stop when the hour is uncertain; confirm service status online, then use dine-in, takeout, or curbside pickup.
cards.short_summary: A round-the-clock restaurant serving breakfast and broader diner-style meals.
cards.evidence_claim: IHOP's official location page lists the 5039 28th Street SE restaurant as open 24 hours every day, with dine-in and takeout.
cards.source_title: IHOP Breakfast Restaurants Near You at 5039 28th St SE
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours Monday–Sunday; the official page lists dine-in, takeout, curbside pickup, and online ordering.

cards.title: Grand Coney Around the Clock
cards.subtitle: A 24-hour classic diner on Michigan Street NE
cards.notes: Head here for a seated diner meal at any hour; review the direct menu first if dietary needs or a specific order matter.
cards.short_summary: A local 24-hour diner with Coney dogs, breakfast dishes, comfort food, and milkshakes.
cards.evidence_claim: Grand Coney's official website identifies its 809 Michigan Street NE diner and states that it is open 24 hours.
cards.source_title: Grand Coney Diner | 24/7 Restaurant Grand Rapids
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours according to the restaurant's official website; pickup and delivery ordering are also offered.

cards.title: The 4 A.M. Drive-Thru
cards.subtitle: Tacos and burritos on the 28th Street corridor
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru for the latest posted service window; dine-in closes earlier, so check the service mode before leaving.
cards.short_summary: A late-running fast-food counter whose drive-thru extends well beyond its dining-room schedule.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru hours of 7 a.m.–4 a.m. every day at its 2829 28th Street SE location.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell in Grand Rapids, MI — 2829 28th Street SE
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru is posted as open until 4 a.m. daily; dine-in hours are shorter and should be checked separately.

cards.title: Wendy's Past Midnight
cards.subtitle: A drive-thru open until 1 or 2 a.m.
cards.notes: Check the day before departing: Friday and Saturday run an hour later, while the posted Sunday–Thursday close is 1 a.m.
cards.short_summary: A Breton-and-28th fast-food stop with nightly service after midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy's lists restaurant and drive-thru hours until 1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 2 a.m. Friday–Saturday at this location.
cards.source_title: Wendy's Breton & 28th in Grand Rapids, MI
cards.access_notes: Open until 1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 2 a.m. Friday–Saturday; the official page posts the same window for drive-thru service.

cards.title: Wingstop at One
cards.subtitle: Carryout and delivery scheduled through 1 a.m.
cards.notes: Place the order before the posted cutoff and select carryout or delivery; the official page does not promise late dine-in seating.
cards.short_summary: A wing-focused counter with the same late closing time throughout the week.
cards.evidence_claim: Wingstop's official page lists carryout and delivery hours through 1 a.m. every day at 3923 28th Street SE.
cards.access_notes: Carryout and delivery are posted from 10:30 a.m.–1 a.m. Sunday–Saturday; verify order acceptance before traveling.

cards.title: Papa Johns Until One
cards.subtitle: Late pizza ordering on Kalamazoo Avenue SE
cards.notes: Order online before setting out and confirm whether pickup or delivery has the later cutoff; service windows can differ by method.
cards.short_summary: A southeast Grand Rapids pizza shop with ordering available into the early morning.
cards.evidence_claim: Papa Johns' official Grand Rapids listing identifies the 4236 Kalamazoo Avenue SE store and shows it closing at 1 a.m.
cards.source_title: Papa Johns Grand Rapids MI Locations
cards.access_notes: The official city listing shows the Kalamazoo Avenue SE location closing at 1 a.m.; verify pickup and delivery cutoffs when ordering.

cards.title: Pizza Hut at Midnight
cards.subtitle: Friday and Saturday carryout or delivery until midnight
cards.notes: Save this run for Friday or Saturday if you need the midnight window; Sunday–Thursday closing times are earlier.
cards.short_summary: A pizza carryout and delivery option with an extended weekend schedule.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Hut lists delivery and carryout until midnight Friday and Saturday at 6670 Kalamazoo Avenue SE.
cards.source_title: Pizza Hut: Pizza & Wings — 6670 Kalamazoo SE
cards.access_notes: Delivery and carryout run until midnight Friday–Saturday and 11 p.m. Sunday–Thursday; delivery hours may vary.

cards.title: The Late Culver's Drive-Thru
cards.subtitle: An 11 p.m. Thursday–Saturday drive-thru
cards.notes: Go Thursday through Saturday for the latest window and use the drive-thru; the lobby and Curdside service close sooner.
cards.short_summary: A 28th Street stop whose late-week drive-thru outlasts the dining room.
cards.evidence_claim: Culver's lists drive-thru hours through 11 p.m. Thursday–Saturday at its Cascade restaurant, with daily lobby service until 10 p.m.
cards.source_title: Culver's of Grand Rapids, MI — Cascade
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru closes at 11 p.m. Thursday–Saturday and 10 p.m. Sunday–Wednesday; lobby closes at 10 p.m. daily.

cards.entity_name: Jimmy John's — 2751 East Beltline Avenue SE
cards.title: The 10 P.M. Sandwich Stop
cards.subtitle: Pickup, seating, and delivery beside Calvin's corridor
cards.notes: Order by 10 p.m. and choose pickup, delivery, or indoor seating; leave time for preparation before the posted closing hour.
cards.short_summary: An East Beltline sandwich shop with a consistent daily evening schedule.
cards.evidence_claim: Jimmy John's lists store and delivery hours through 10 p.m. every day at 2751 East Beltline Avenue SE and confirms indoor seating.
cards.source_title: Sandwich Shop in Grand Rapids | Jimmy John's 0671
cards.access_notes: Store and delivery hours are posted as 9 a.m.–10 p.m. daily; the official page also confirms indoor seating.
